parameters.help_en:
The production studio ID.

If you created the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848012.html, check the CasterId parameter returned by the CreateCaster operation.

If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to ApsaraVideo Live console > Production Studios > Cloud Production Studio to view the ID.

The production studio name in the production studio list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID.
If this parameter is left empty, the merged data of all production studios is returned by default
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848012.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。
若参数为空，默认返回所有导播台合并后的数据

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to sort the production studios in ascending order by modification time.

Valid values: true (ascending order by modification time) | false (descending order by modification time, which is the default value).

If this parameter is not specified, the default value is "false"
parameters.help_zh:
是否按照导播台的修改时间进行升序排序。

有效值：true（按修改时间升序排列）| false（按修改时间降序排列，默认值）。

不填默认为"false"

parameters.help_en:

schema.description_en: The query result of the production studio list
schema.description_zh: 导播台列表信息查询结果

CasterId.description_en: The production studio ID. This ID can be used as a request parameter for querying production studio stream URLs, starting a production studio, adding video resources to a production studio, adding layouts to a production studio, querying the layout list of a production studio, adding components to a production studio, and adding a program list to a production studio
CasterId.description_zh: 导播台ID。可作为查询导播台流地址、启动导播台、添加导播台视频资源、添加导播台布局、查询导播台布局列表、添加导播台组件和添加导播台节目单的请求参数

CasterName.description_en: The name of the production studio

CasterTemplate.description_en:
The resolution configuration of the production studio. This parameter is required when the billing method is subscription.  

lp_ld: low definition.

lp_sd: standard definition.

lp_hd: high definition.

lp_ud: ultra-high definition.

lp_ld_v: portrait low definition.

lp_sd_v: portrait standard definition.

lp_hd_v: portrait high definition.

lp_ud_v: portrait ultra-high definition
CasterTemplate.description_zh:
导播台分辨率配置，付费类型为预付费时必选。  

lp_ld：流畅。

lp_sd：标清。

lp_hd：高清。

lp_ud：超清。

lp_ld_v：竖屏流畅。

lp_sd_v：竖屏标清。

lp_hd_v：竖屏高清。

lp_ud_v：竖屏超清

ChannelEnable.description_en:
Indicates whether Channel is enabled.

0: disabled.

1: enabled

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method.  

PrePaid: subscription.

PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
ChargeType.description_zh:
付费方式。  

PrePaid：预付费。

PostPaid：后付费

ClientTokenId.description_en: The request token generated by the user to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value of this parameter is custom but must be unique across different requests. The maximum length is 64 ASCII characters
ClientTokenId.description_zh:
用户生成的请求 token，用于保证请求的幂等性。
该参数值可自定义，但是要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符

CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the production studio. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
ExpireTime.description_zh: 导播台过期时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）

LastModified.description_en: The time when the production studio was last modified. For example, the time when the production studio was recently started, stopped, or had its configuration modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
LastModified.description_zh: 对导播台最新修改时间。例如：近期有对导播台进行过开启，停止，修改配置等操作的时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）

NormType.description_en:
The specification type of the production studio. Valid values:  

0: playlist mode.

1: general mode
NormType.description_zh:
导播台规格类型 。 取值：  

0：播单型。

1：通用型

PurchaseTime.description_en: The time when the production studio was purchased. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
PurchaseTime.description_zh: 导播台购买时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The resource group ID. For more information about resource groups, see [What is a resource group]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2381067.html）
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 资源组ID。关于资源组的更多信息，请参见[什么是资源组]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2381067.html）

StartTime.description_en: The time when the production studio was started. This parameter is returned only when the production studio is in the streaming state. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
StartTime.description_zh: 导播台启动时间，当导播台处于导播中时输出。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）
